final: SELECT ga.MediaTypeId, ga.avg_price, ga.avg_price / oa.overall_avg as division FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_price FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MediaTypeId) ga CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_price) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_price FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MediaTypeId) WHERE avg_price IS NOT NULL) oa WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND ga.avg_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY division DESC, MediaTypeId LIMIT 10
